aura-avatar-ui.service.unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-avatar-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA cached avatar touchscreen interface
Wants=xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
After=local-fs.target xserver-nodm.service systemd-modules-load.service
RequiresMountsFor=/home/root/aura-automatic-conversation-20261018/candidate-b1b08f8b0b2b/runtime
StartLimitIntervalSec=300
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
Environment=DISPLAY=:0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-automatic-conversation-20261018/candidate-b1b08f8b0b2b/runtime/aura
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-automatic-conversation-20261018/candidate-b1b08f8b0b2b/startup/launcher.py --config /home/root/aura-automatic-conversation-20261018/candidate-b1b08f8b0b2b/startup/config.json
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=240
TimeoutStopSec=25
KillMode=mixed
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=aura-avatar-ui

[Install]
WantedBy=graphical.target

aura-camera-ui.service.unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/aura-camera-ui.service
[Unit]
Description=AURA shared USB camera preview and YOLOX person adapter
After=local-fs.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /home/root/aura-avatar-gtk-stage/runtime-1a8677ce-20261009/aura/board/vision/ui_camera_service.py
WorkingDirectory=/home/root/aura-avatar-gtk-stage/runtime-1a8677ce-20261009/aura
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
